summary: v1.3 testing complete. Both new features pass all backend + UI checks. POST /api/bb/replay (Burp-style replay) returns correctly-shaped response, validates http(s) scheme (400 on ftp), and forwards body/cookies. Every vuln finding of the relevant types (sqli_error, xss_reflected, command_injection, lfi, csrf_missing, git_exposure, backup_file) carries a cvss{score,vector,severity} object with vector starting 'CVSS:3.1/' and a curl reproducer starting 'curl -i -k'. Markdown report contains both 'CVSS 3.1:' and ```bash code fences. UI brand still shows v1.2 (per spec), tab-replay renders with all expected sub-fields, send works against vulnserver, and btn-replay-sqli_error correctly switches tabs and prefills the URL. Full backend regression: 27/27 pass (10 v1.0 + 6 v1.1 + 5 v1.2 + 6 v1.3).
critical_code_review_comments: bb_api.replay: no SSRF guard. The endpoint will happily fetch http://169.254.169.254/, http://localhost/admin, etc. Same trust model as the scanner but worth a follow-up — accept only an allow-list of hosts that appear in the user's recent scans, or require i_have_authorization in the payload.
bb_api.replay: body is .encode()-ed with default UTF-8; binary payloads (e.g., multipart with raw bytes) will be mangled. Consider accepting base64 + content-type override for binary bodies.
bb_api.replay imports requests inside the function — fine for cold-load isolation but slightly wasteful per-call; move to module top with a session for connection reuse.
vuln._enrich_finding: csrf_missing branch hard-codes '--data amount=10&to=alice' which is project-specific. Consider deriving from the actual form fields when available.
cvss.CVSS_BY_TYPE is fine but does not cover 'sqli_boolean'/'sqli_time' findings emitted under other type strings — verify the exploit modules emit those exact keys.
Frontend ReplayView: response body is rendered as text — large binary responses could blow the DOM. The backend already truncates at 200KB, so OK in practice.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the v1.3 UI checks (brand, tab-replay, all replay form sub-fields, btn-replay-send round-trip, finding-cvss/btn-replay-/btn-copy- in vuln tab, btn-replay-sqli_error tab switch + URL prefill)
